UPDATE: DILG Sec. Jonvic Remulla proposed banning street parking in Metro Manila from 5:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. to ease road congestion.
 
MMDA Chairperson Romando Artes, meanwhile, proposed a no side-street parking policy during morning and afternoon rush hours.
 
The suggestions were presented in a meeting between Metro Manila mayors, the MMDA, DILG, and the PNP on Friday, August 1. | via @michael_delizo

BAN SA STREET PARKING

Iminungkahi ni Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Sec. Jonvic Remulla na ipagbawal ang street parking sa ilang kalsada sa Metro Manila mula 5:00 a.m. hanggang 10:00 p.m. para maibsan ang traffic congestion.

Ayon kay Remulla, magtatalaga ang ahensya ng technical working group para tukuyin ang mga kalsada kung saan ito maaaring ipatupad.

“We’re going to be very strict about it. Gagawan namin ng whole city map para makita kung saan pwedeng pumarada at saan hindi,” saad ni Sec. Remulla sa meeting ng Metro Manila mayors, MMDA, DILG, at PNP ngayong Biyernes, August 1.
